answer: A comet-window live audit with a marble tally and cipher-sealed receipts blocks fake aliases from paid work. Each new alias draws a random 2-hour audit window each epoch and must finish a live task inside it while 3 proctors watch. Each passed audit adds one marble to a public tally, and an alias needs 12 marbles before it can bid on jobs above 100 POA. Each job receipt is sealed with a cipher key the jury opens only in a dispute, so copied output shows up as a mismatch. An alias caught faking loses all its marbles, pays a 150 POA fine, and waits 4 epochs for another window.
